svg.title: Project 10: fantasy character (dragon)
svg.text: Trace the scale area, horns and crest, then paint the scales row by row from the bottom up. Lesson 09.3.
Must measure 10 cm. If not, print at 100% ("Actual size").
Circles on the horn line: the wide base and the thin tip. Gray dot: gem place. Scales fade out at the edges.
Red dotted ovals: eye area. Only eye-safe liner there; scales, horns and gems stay outside.
